accounts.rule_applied: Explicit churn signal: no value, and the pilot ends in 46 days
accounts.headline: Operations director says nothing is usable, and the pilot ends 1 May
accounts.detail: Says our downtime report duplicates their own system; packing counts are still wrong.

why.reason: The operations director said the pilot has produced nothing usable and that they will not continue unless the board sees something different by the pilot end.
why.quote: If I can't show the board something different by then, we won't continue.

why.reason: The downtime report is seen as a copy of what their own system already shows.
Packing-station counts were wrong in two separate weeks and the line team stopped checking them.

accounts.support_needed: A leadership call before 1 April with one result the customer's own system cannot show, and the packing-count fix confirmed on site.

accounts.rule_applied: Relayed statement pointing to risk (cannot make red alone)
accounts.headline: Procurement is asking how many licences they really need next year
accounts.detail: Relayed after the call, not said on it. The engineer's own feedback is positive.

why.reason: After the call, the production engineer mentioned that procurement asked how many licences they really need next year.
On the recorded call the line is stable and stop clips were used in two root-cause sessions.
why.quote: We used the stop clips in two root-cause sessions this week.

accounts.rule_applied: One strong signal (disengagement), 2 weeks so far
accounts.headline: Plant manager has missed two calls and line 2 is 'not a priority this month'
accounts.detail: Line 3 is used every morning; the expansion decision has stalled.

why.reason: The plant manager, who asked for line 2 in February, has not joined the last two weekly calls and has not read the line 2 plan.
why.quote: He hasn't looked at it yet. It's not a priority this month.
